neighbours.label: a conference, congress, workshop or summit as what the sentence is about (会议, congress of the society, a two-day workshop), peaking on 会议 or on punctuation after it, as opposed to family, school or leisure events in the same frames
fire: 这次国际会议在上海举行，会议讨论了气候问题。
上个月的学术会议在东京召开。会议的主题是能源。
The annual congress of the academy met in Prague, on the theme of river law.
The three-day symposium, held in Lisbon in June, brought together experts on malaria.
A two-day workshop on soil science, held in Nairobi, closed with a shared report.
The summit of regional leaders concluded in Geneva with a statement on trade.
第五届世界会议在巴黎开幕，会议吸引了许多专家。
The 12th international conference of the society took place in Seoul, under the theme of aging.
quiet: 这次家庭旅行在上海结束，大家吃了很多东西。
上个月的学校比赛在东京举行。比赛的项目是游泳。
The annual reunion of the family met in Prague, on a warm afternoon by the river.
The three-day holiday, spent in Lisbon in June, brought together old friends from school.
A two-day camping trip on the coast, begun in Nairobi, closed with a shared meal.
The picnic of the local neighbors ended in Geneva with a song by the lake.
第五届春节晚会在巴黎开始，晚会吸引了许多孩子。
The 12th birthday party of my nephew took place in Seoul, under a big paper tent.

short: a scholarly or diplomatic meeting as the topic
notes: Card: '.' x6, ',' x5, '会议' x2, ' summit' x2, ';' x2; the - pole is ' at' in 'paper presented at'. Probes: 国际会议 ... 会议 0.44-0.70, workshop 0.44, society meeting 0.45, congress 0.34, summit 0.23-0.27; school event 活动 0.29, picnic 0.18, birthday 0.17, trip 0.16, hike 0.15. Separation is modest, and near misses are not silent.
